subject: Error in runModels(filefilter = modelout) :   runModels cannot change to directory: E:

messages.author: 10e755fb7577ddca
messages.subject: Error in runModels(filefilter = modelout) :   runModels cannot change to directory: E:
parts:
Hello Michael,

 

I have just installed MplusAutomation.

I am using the R French version 3.2.2 on a Windows7 Dell Latitude E6430s portable computer

I use MPLUS 7.1 release.

I tried to run the little path analysis model below and I Get this error message :

Error in runModels(filefilter = modelout) :   runModels cannot change to directory: E:

 

R version 3.2.2 (2015-08-14) -- "Fire Safety"

Copyright (C) 2015 The R Foundation for Statistical Computing

Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)

 

R est un logiciel libre livré sans AUCUNE GARANTIE.

Vous pouvez le redistribuer sous certaines conditions.

Tapez 'license()' ou 'licence()' pour plus de détails.

 

R est un projet collaboratif avec de nombreux contributeurs.

Tapez 'contributors()' pour plus d'information et

'citation()' pour la façon de le citer dans les publications.

 

Tapez 'demo()' pour des démonstrations, 'help()' pour l'aide

en ligne ou 'help.start()' pour obtenir l'aide au format HTML.

Tapez 'q()' pour quitter R.

 

[Sauvegarde de la session précédente restaurée]

 

> library(MplusAutomation)

> pathmodel <- mplusObject(

+    TITLE = "MplusAutomation Example - Path Model;",

+    MODEL = "

+      mpg ON hp;

+      wt ON disp;",

+    rdata = mtcars)

No R variables to use specified.

Selected automatically as any variable name that occurs in the MODEL or DEFINE section.

> fit <- mplusModeler(pathmodel, "mtcars.dat", modelout = "model1.inp", run = 1L)

Wrote model to: model1.inp

Wrote data to: mtcars.dat

Error in runModels(filefilter = modelout) :

  runModels cannot change to directory: E:

 

However, I found that the files model1.out, model1.inp and mtcars.dat have been written to E:

 

Can you please help me to understand what went wrong ?

Thank you for your help

messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] Error in runModels(filefilter = modelout) : runModels cannot change to directory: E:
parts:
Hi Jean-Louis,

For a quick fix, I think it should work if you run R in a subdirectory.  For example, change the working directory from "E:/" to "E:/models" or something like that.

This seems to be a bug in the regular expression that checks whether a directory exists that fails in the case where the working directory is at the root of a drive, like E:/.  I will have a patch for this shortly, but I need to see if this is unique to Windows or also applies on Mac and Linux first.

I'll send a follow-up when its fixed.

Cheers,

Josh

messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] Error in runModels(filefilter = modelout) : runModels cannot change to directory: E:
parts:
Hi Jean-Louis,

I believe it is fixed now on the development version of MplusAutomation.  You can install this from github using the devtools package (will need to install that if you have not already):

library(devtools)
install_github("michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation")

Best wishes,

Josh

I'll send a follow-up when its fixed.
